posts.title: blogkitty: A RSS Feed Manager in Discord
posts.description: Hi! I wanted a way to monitor blogs for members in my Discord server, so I created a bot which will monitor RSS feeds into channels with just one command. You can check out the project here ! How it Works When you run the /monitor [rss-feed] [channel-name] command in Discord, the bot will create a channel with that name and stream any updates from rss-feed into it.
